{{Quote|The deeds of heroes send ripples through the Force. Anakin's life continues to flow outward, touching and guiding those who have yet to hear his name. Most of us here use the Force&mdash;this young man embodied it.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
The '''Funeral of Anakin Solo''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], once the survivors of the [[Myrkr strike team]] returned the body of their fallen leader, [[Anakin Solo]], to his parents [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. The ceremony took place at night, in a secluded clearing in a mountain forest. A stone bier was constructed and the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] body laid upon it.

Family and friends gathered to pay their respects, and several delivered brief eulogies for Solo. Once [[Kyp Durron]] had voiced his sentiments on the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] role in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Anakin Solo's uncle, came forward to cremate the body, as was customary at [[Jedi funeral/Legends|Jedi funerals]].
